The new M5 Ultra Mac Studio is an absolute monster, but how big is the upgrade over the M3 Ultra?
In this video, we unbox and take a first look at the new M5 Ultra Mac Studio, put it through a bunch of benchmarks, and directly compare its performance with the M3 Ultra Mac Studio.
More importantly, we test where all this power actually matters: AI workloads, local LLMs, GPU performance, sustained workloads, memory-heavy tasks and real-world creator workflows.
